description: Set the combination of PIC-FLIP velocity update used for the material points for the mechanical models (default f =0.01). For Dynamic models, the value is set using the mpoint dynamic pic-fraction command. FLIP velocity update is obtained for a fraction f =0. This method is the standard in MPM simulations, but can result in artificial noise. PIC velocity update is obtained for a fraction f =1. This method may be more stable than FLIP but it filters velocities and dissipates more energy. A fraction 0 < f < 1 of PIC velocity can help dampen the artificial noise of the FLIP update while limiting dissipation of the PIC update. This may help stabilize some complex analyses that are sensitive to noise such as fracture and failure simulations.
